technique_name: How has digital technology improved communication in society?
description: Digital technology has revolutionized the way people communicate in society. It has enabled people to communicate more quickly and more reliably. For example, the emergence of email and text messaging has significantly reduced the time it takes for people to communicate with one another. This technology has led to the emergence of social media networks and online messaging tools that allow people to communicate more efficiently. Additionally, digital technology has enabled people to collaborate
